fields.subject: Vending Machines in Concourse B
fields.description: The Coke machines at Gate B2 and B6 just spit out all their cans at once. There is soda everywhere. Maintenance needed for cleanup. Is this a cyber thing?

activity.author: Service Desk Agent
activity.text: Caller reports both machines dispensed full inventory with no purchase. Vendor telemetry units are on the tenant network. Routing to IT for review.

activity.author: System
activity.text: Incident created · State: New · Priority: 4 - Low
